channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Are GCC countries looking for a regional security pact with Iran?
item.description: Observers say diverging views are unlikely to turn current diplomatic efforts into a lasting infrastructure.

item.title: Espionage threats blur lines between security and dissent in Iran
item.description: Iran is using the threat of spy networks to detain and execute political opponents, analysts say.

item.title: Why are three of the UK’s four nuclear deterrent submarines at sea?
item.description: The deployment marks the first time in years that three Vanguard-class vessels have been at sea at the same time.

item.title: Victims of Jordan’s air strikes in Syria
item.description: Jordan’s air strikes in southern Syria killed at least seven people, including three children. Here are their stories.

item.title: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios
item.description: With 85% of votes counted, all signs point to an impasse. The most likely outcome may be new elections.

item.title: Serbian shot dead after attacking officer outside Israeli embassy, minister says
item.description: Authorities say the attacker in Belgrade was an underage male who was being monitored by security services.

item.title: Israel's election result is messy - here's why
item.description: Despite having the highest voter turnout in nearly three decades, Israel's elections have had no clear winner. What does this mean for the country, asks the BBC's Yolande Knell.

item.title: What does Israel's election mean for Gaza and the wider world?
item.description: The BBC's diplomatic correspondent James Landale reports from Jerusalem as ballots are cast.
